about_the_game:
Soar back into the clouds with the official Sky Oceans: Wings for Hire Original Soundtrack. Composed by Matías Castro Cancino, the album blends sweeping themes, intimate character moments and high-stakes battle cues that capture the heart of Glenn Windwalker’s journey and the spirit of his crew. This anniversary release includes new recordings that highlight fan-favourite motifs and the signature sound of Sky Oceans.

About the composer

Matías Castro Cancino is a professional composer active since 2010, known for music that combines emotional depth with cinematic impact. His work spans film, animation and games, with credits including Sky Oceans: Wings for Hire and The Spirit of the Samurai. His music has featured in campaigns for The Book of Boba Fett, Moon Knight and Mortal Kombat 1. He also creates sci-fi inspired ambient music as Darkest Dreams, crafting immersive soundscapes with analogue synthesisers and orchestral elements.

What you get

• A character-driven score that celebrates Glenn, Garrote and the crew

• New recordings created for the anniversary release

• A dynamic range of pieces evoking exploration, story and combat

• Original music by Matías Castro Cancino

Bonus Live Orchestra Versions

These pieces were performed live as part of the first concert of Chilean video game composers at Teatro Cervantes in Valdivia, Chile.

This incredible moment was made possible thanks to the efforts of Patrick Moore and Francisco Cerda.

The arrangements and orchestration were beautifully crafted by Andres Alejandro Hernández Sarmiento.

Recording by Eva Reistad and Estudio Aplauso.

Performed by the Orquesta Filarmónica de Los Ríos, conducted by Maestro Marco Alarcón.
